name: Islamic Succession
dataProvenance: Quranic inheritance verses (Surah An-Nisa 4:11-12), classical fiqh (Hanafi, Shafi'i, Maliki, Hanbali schools)
description: Faraid rules: heir classification, fixed shares, residuary (asaba), awl/radd adjustments, wasiyya limits, iddah periods, waqf, mahr.
